about: StepTimers' duration words. patterns: case-insensitive regex fragments, matched after a number (whole words in a spaced language; Japanese needs no boundary, so '5分煮る' reads). seconds is how long one of that unit lasts. A smaller unit straight after a larger one continues the duration ('1時間30分'). followOn: regex fragments that may join the two parts. label: how a timer button writes the unit. '2分の1' is a half, '8分目' a level, '5分割' a division, and '1時間半' or '1分半' has a half the pattern can't add, so none of them is a time.
